title: Align release dependency wait with quality timeout
outOfScope: release publication, tag creation, and asset upload
changing smoke or compatibility test contents

sources.reason: Release workflow dependency wait and timeout behavior.
Smoke quality job timeout defines the dependent run upper bound.
Compatibility quality job timeout and source-bound dependent run.
Release workflow ordering and wait policy regression coverage.
Workflow contract and timeout consistency tests.
Required full Work Item lifecycle and fail-closed rules.
WI-18 release process issue record and serial corrective order.

rawUserRequest: Continue the complete serial Work Item process. When release preflight or provider execution finds a process or evidence-binding problem, record it, correct it in a dedicated Work Item, complete its PR and cleanup lifecycle, and only then resume publication.

declaredIntent.summary: Prevent release publication from timing out while waiting for source-bound smoke quality that is allowed to run up to the configured quality timeout.

riskAssessment.reason: An undersized dependency wait can abort a valid source-bound release; an oversized or weakened wait could hide stale or unrelated CI evidence.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized serial corrective Work Items with complete PR, merge, close, cleanup, and recorded process issues; publication remains separately gated.

preReviewWarnings: The wait must remain source-bound, fail closed, bounded, and aligned with smoke/compatibility timeout policy; do not remove dependent workflow validation.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Release dependency wait is at least the configured smoke/compatibility quality timeout and remains bounded.
The wait still selects successful runs only for the exact SOURCE_COMMIT and fails closed on timeout or failure.
Tests verify the wait duration, source-bound filtering, and timeout failure behavior.
The execution plan records RFE-ISSUE-038 and RFE-ISSUE-039 and remains aligned.
The full Work Item lifecycle is completed: finish, archive, PR, merge, close, branch cleanup, base synchronization, and plan alignment.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Exact-source smoke and compatibility complete within bounded wait

scenarioCoverage.reason: Explicitly out of scope; publication remains blocked until this corrective Work Item closes.

guidelines: Use one explicit bounded timeout aligned with dependent workflow timeout policy.
Preserve exact SOURCE_COMMIT filtering and fail-closed timeout behavior.
Do not publish a release from this Work Item.

intent.problem: Release run 30209749886 aborted after 900 seconds while waiting for the exact-source smoke run, even though the dependent quality job is allowed to run for 30 minutes; compatibility had succeeded and no tag or Release was created.
constraints: Keep smoke and compatibility selection bound to the exact SOURCE_COMMIT.
Keep the wait bounded and fail closed when no successful dependent run exists.
Do not publish from this corrective Work Item.
intent.rationale: Align the release dependency wait with the configured dependent quality timeout, preserving source filtering and explicit failure rather than allowing a valid dependent run to outlive the release gate.
